messages:
sophia: Quick thread to capture the speculative-decode sweep I ran this morning. Goal: latency win for draft‑model bring-up without large QA regressions. Results summarized below — short and messy notes.
raj: cool, drop the baseline numbers pls
sophia: Baselines: greedy on draft-3 (6B) q4_0 on runtime v2.3 — avg ~35ms/token (seq512, batch=8, A100). beam=5 ~60ms/token.

Speculative config tried: topk=5 prefix-heuristic, speculative p=0.02, fallback to greedy. With prefix/KV warm and batching, avg token time -> 24ms (approx 30% speedup). Throughput up ~1.35x under our chat workload.

ana: what about quality? numbers matter
sophia: QA EM dropped 1.8 pts absolute vs baseline greedy on our validation split. MCQ (closed‑book) saw ~4.5 pts drop. Open-ended chat fluency HPS (human pass/fail) stayed within noise (0.5% delta). So tradeoff is workload dependent.

mike: did you run with quant variants? q4_0 interacts funny with speculative sampling sometimes
sophia: yes — main sweep was q4_0. Quick ablation: q4_1 had slightly better QA (−0.9 pts vs q4_0) but cost was +6ms/token. q8_0 restored most QA but latency back to ~32ms. Conclusion: speculate + q4_0 = best latency but highest QA hit.

eval-bot: automated-eval summary attached: {EM_delta: -1.8, MCQ_delta: -4.5, Perplexity_delta: +0.7, Throughput_x: 1.35}
raj: do we have qualitative failure modes? any systemic hallucination patterns?
sophia: flagged cases mostly short factual recall (dates/numbers) and some multi-step reasoning. Pattern: speculate picks a plausible token early, fallback sometimes not triggered because beam/score margin small.

ana: could we tighten the fallback criterion? maybe margin threshold or temperature annealing
sophia: plan: next run with margin threshold 0.12 (was default 0.05), topk=8, p=0.01. Also add a gated rerank step: after speculative prefix, compute a fast scorer (log-prob delta) and force fallback if below threshold.

mike: infra note — long runs (100k prompts) need reserved slot on the dedicated pool. @ci-bot can you schedule a 6h run on dedicated-gpu-3?
ci-bot: booking request received. ETA queue 2h — will post when started. :thumbsup:

raj: suggest adding adversarial subset to eval: numeric-recall and multi-hop Qs. If speculate consistently hurts those, we should exclude from rollout or use per-route policy.

sophia: agreed — I'll split eval into (1) conversational, (2) factual-numeric, (3) multi-hop. We'll compute per-route SLOs and a degradation guard.

ana: also worth checking interaction with caching: prefix cache warm vs cold. Did you test cold-cache latencies?
sophia: good call — current numbers are warm-KV. Cold startup showed smaller relative wins (speculative overhead adds a tiny startup penalty). I'll instrument cold vs warm in the next sweep.

mike: timeline? when can we get full ablation (quant variants + margin tuning + adversarial eval)
sophia: aiming to kick off infra run in ~3h, results ~overnight. I'll post a short summary and a triage doc with recommended rollout policy (per-route on/off + quant fallback).

raj: thanks. if human eval stays flat we can try a canary on low-traffic opt-in route. :eyes:
sophia: noted. will prep canary spec and prompt set. Thanks all — will update when ci-bot posts run start/finish.
